title: will/shall (2)
summary: **I'll ...** — когда решаем или предлагаем помощь прямо в момент речи; **Shall I / Shall we ...?** — предложение и вопрос «как лучше?».
ru:
## I'll ... — решение в момент речи
Когда мы **только что решили** что-то сделать или хотим **предложить помощь**, используем **I'll** (I will).
> My bag is very heavy. — **I'll carry** it for you. — Сумка очень тяжёлая. — Я понесу её.
> **I'll phone** you tomorrow, OK? — Я позвоню завтра, ладно?
> It's cold. **I'll close** the window. — Холодно. Я закрою окно.

## I think I'll ... / I don't think I'll ...
Это частые фразы, когда мы решаем прямо сейчас.
> I'm tired. I **think I'll go** to bed early. — Я устала. Пожалуй, лягу спать пораньше.
> It's a nice day. I **think I'll sit** in the garden. — Хороший день. Пожалуй, посижу в саду.
> It's raining. I **don't think I'll go** out. — Дождь. Пожалуй, не пойду гулять.

## Не present simple!
В таких предложениях нельзя использовать present simple.
- ~~I phone you tomorrow.~~ → I'**ll phone** you tomorrow.
- ~~I think I go to bed early.~~ → I think I'**ll go** to bed early.

## Но если решение принято раньше
Когда план или договорённость **уже есть**, I'll не используем.
> I'm working tomorrow. (не I'll work)
> There's a good film on TV tonight. I'm **going to watch** it. (не I'll watch)
> What are you doing at the weekend? (не What will you do)

## Shall I ...? / Shall we ...?
**Shall I / shall we** — вопрос «Предложить? Это хорошая идея?». Только с I и we.
> It's very warm here. **Shall I open** the window? — Здесь жарко. Открыть окно?
> **Shall I phone** you this evening? — Yes, please. — Позвонить тебе вечером? — Да, пожалуйста.
> It's a nice day. **Shall we go** for a walk? — Хороший день. Пойдём гулять?
> What **shall I wear**? — Что мне надеть?
> Where **shall we go** for our holidays? — Куда нам поехать в отпуск?
> What time **shall we meet**? — Во сколько встретимся?

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Shall you help me?~~ → **Will** you help me? / Can you help me?
- ~~I'll to carry it.~~ → I'll carry it.
- ~~Shall I to open the window?~~ → Shall I open the window?
en:
## I'll ... — a decision at the moment of speaking
We use **I'll** (I will) when we **decide** to do something at the moment of speaking, or when we **offer** to do something.
> My bag is very heavy. — **I'll carry** it for you.
> **I'll phone** you tomorrow, OK?
> It's cold. **I'll close** the window.

## I think I'll ... / I don't think I'll ...
We often say this when we decide something now.
> I'm tired. I **think I'll go** to bed early.
> It's a nice day. I **think I'll sit** in the garden.
> It's raining. I **don't think I'll go** out.

## Not the present simple!
- ~~I phone you tomorrow.~~ → I'**ll phone** you tomorrow.
- ~~I think I go to bed early.~~ → I think I'**ll go** to bed early.

## But not for earlier plans
We don't use **I'll** for something we decided before (Units 26–27).
> I'm working tomorrow. (not I'll work)
> There's a good film on TV tonight. I'm **going to watch** it. (not I'll watch)
> What are you doing at the weekend? (not What will you do)

## Shall I ...? / Shall we ...?
**Shall I / shall we ...?** = Do you think this is a good idea? We use it only with I and we.
> It's very warm here. **Shall I open** the window?
> **Shall I phone** you this evening? — Yes, please.
> It's a nice day. **Shall we go** for a walk?
> What **shall I wear**?
> Where **shall we go** for our holidays?
> What time **shall we meet**?

## Common mistakes
- ~~Shall you help me?~~ → **Will** you help me?
- ~~I'll to carry it.~~ → I'll carry it.
- ~~Shall I to open the window?~~ → Shall I open the window?
structure:
## I'll — решение и предложение
| Ситуация | Пример |
|---|---|
| предложить помощь | My bag is heavy. — I'll carry it. |
| решить сейчас | I'm hungry. I'll make a sandwich. |
| обещать | I'll call you tomorrow. |
| отказ (отрицание) | I won't tell anybody. |

## Формулы
> **I'll** + глагол (без to)
> I **think I'll** + глагол · I **don't think I'll** + глагол

## Shall I / Shall we
| Конструкция | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **Shall I** + глагол ...? | предложить сделать самому | Shall I open the window? |
| **Shall we** + глагол ...? | предложить сделать вместе | Shall we go for a walk? |
| **What shall I** + глагол ...? | спросить совета | What shall I wear? |
| **Where / What time shall we** + глагол ...? | договориться | What time shall we meet? |

## Краткие ответы
- Shall I open the window? — Yes, please. / No, thanks.
- Shall we go? — Yes, let's. / OK.

## Когда не I'll
| Что | Как сказать |
|---|---|
| уже договорились | I'm meeting Tom tomorrow. |
| давно решили | I'm going to learn English. |
| решаем сейчас | I'll have the soup. |

exercises.title: Предложите помощь
exercises.instruction: Допишите ответ с **I'll** и глаголом из скобок.
exercises.example: My bag is very heavy. (carry) → I'll carry it for you.

items.text: My bag is very heavy. — I {{will carry|'ll carry}} it for you.
I'm going on holiday. — OK, I {{will send|'ll send}} you a postcard.
I don't want this banana. — I {{will eat|'ll eat}} it.
Is there a chair? — Don't worry, I {{will sit|'ll sit}} on the floor.
How do I use this camera? — I {{will show|'ll show}} you.
Are you coming with me? — No, I {{will stay|'ll stay}} here.

exercises.title: I think I'll ...
exercises.instruction: Допишите предложение с **I think I'll** или **I don't think I'll**.

items.text: I'm tired. I think {{I'll|I will}} go to bed early.
It's a nice day. I think {{I'll|I will}} sit in the garden.
It's raining. I don't think {{I'll|I will}} go out.
The film is long. I don't think {{I'll|I will}} watch it.
I'm hungry. I think {{I'll|I will}} have a sandwich.
It's too expensive. I don't think {{I'll|I will}} buy it.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение или вопрос с **I'll** или **shall**.

items.prompt: (I / think / I / go / to bed early)
answers: I think I'll go to bed early.
I think I will go to bed early.
I don't think I'll go out.
I don't think I will go out.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями о том, что вы решите или предложите.

items.prompt: Вы устали. Что вы решите сделать?
items.sample: I think I'll go to bed early.

items.prompt: Подруга несёт тяжёлую сумку. Предложите помощь.

items.sample: Shall we go to the cinema?
